comment: 58yo male of Ashkenazi heritage, asymptomatic, identified as germline DDX41 p.D140fs (p.Asp140fs) founder-variant carrier on a hereditary-cancer panel ordered after his older brother (age 67) was diagnosed with MDS-EB-2 + a somatic DDX41 R525H second-hit was identified in the tumor's myeloid NGS — the germline-driven pattern was recognized and family screening initiated. Current CBC normal except for slight macrocytosis (MCV 102 fL). Engine routes to PreventionPlan: standard = DDX41 carrier surveillance — CBC q6mo from confirmation (already age 58, past surveillance starting threshold), BMA + cytogenetics + myeloid NGS (including DDX41 R525H hotspot coverage) at any persistent macrocytosis worsening / new cytopenia / dysplastic features, buccal-confirmed cascade testing for his two younger siblings (Ashkenazi founder pattern likely positive cascade rate), donor-germline-screening before any sibling HSC use, treatment-time plan noted favoring hypomethylating agents (azacitidine, decitabine) + venetoclax-based combinations when MDS/AML emerges; alternative = intensified track with q3-4 month CBC, scheduled BMA every 2-3 years from age 58, pre-emptive HLA-typing of sibling cohort, pre-emptive consultation with hereditary-myeloid-program transplant team, structured discussion of donor-search strategy given tighter time-to-transplant in older-adulthood-onset DDX41 disease.
